profile.headline: Principal Systems Engineer/Software Engineer (III) @ Northrop Grumman | CAM, SEIT Lead
profile.summary: Experienced engineer on multiple programs and roles spanning 9+ years as a systems and software engineer including 4 years of software design, test and integrations, and customer delivery.  Seeking opportunities in integration and test with emphasis towards software development and design.

positions.title: Principal Systems Engineer (III)
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Clearance Level: Active
Program: MQ-4C Triton Ground Segment

positions.title: Principal Systems Engineer (III), SEIT Lead and CAM
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Program: JSF F-35 CNI Production Operation Unit – PNR STATE 1.0 – PNR12
•	Consultant and I&T support for two LBPA STE SEIT efforts for Program PNR12.
•	CAM (Cost Account Manager) and SEIT (Systems Engineering Integration and Test) Lead for two LBPA STE (Special Test Equipment) efforts for Program STATE 1.0.
o	Control Account Manager of STEs with an estimate total value of $3.5 million.
o	Completed STE delivery to meet customer’s deadline for production needs.
o	Direct report to the Program manager for Status, schedule, Variance, and Risk Report. Monthly updates to the Integrated Master Schedule for claimed Earned value.
o	Team lead overseeing and assigning tasking to junior engineer and two Production Test Technicians. 
o	Coordination with multiple teams and field which include, but not limited to RF Microwave Design, Electrical Mechanical, Hardware, Software, and Manufacturing Engineers. Coordination with Planning and Scheduling Analyst, Operations Program Management, Quality Assurance, Calibration Team, and Production.
o	Provide training to customer end users on how to operate STE Software and Hardware product.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer (III)
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Program: -
Team Scrum Master - Facilitate daily scrum meetings for team status update and assist with removing team blockers.

Team PoC for SIT - Point of contact for the Software Integration Team for any software development issues and Discrepancy reports.

• Primarily Backend development with limited front-end development only when schemas need to be updated. C++ Backend development test payload and minor front-end development.
• Develop simulated test cases for new capabilities using Perl with collaboration of Systems Engineering team.
• Develop new software capabilities Code Walk Through - Test Procedure 1 - Test Procedure 2 – Run for the Record.
• Responsible Software Engineer for high visibility payload updating and incorporating new capabilities per customer requirements and delivery.
• Test case testing for Systems Engineers to support requirement rollup.
• Support different group effort, MST (multi-segment test) with Dry runs in preparation for RFR (Run for the Record).
• Design contributions to two new payload units for growth capabilities.

positions.title: Systems Engineer/Software Engineer (II)
positions.description:
Northrop Grumman Pathway
(Professional Development Program)

Program: EPS-R (Enhanced Polar Systems - Recapitalization)
•	Verify requirements of Fight Software (FSW) with addition of growth features and configurations. Testing to ensure software robustness for spacecraft and test using Hardware Environment Test set.
•	Support software build delivery to FQT (Formal Qualification Testing) and performed Regression Testing.
•	Surge schedule support assignment to validate multiple Test Tools products and set up EPS-R Flight Software for the programs first FQT milestone. This consists of dry runs, review, updates of test documents for EPS-R compliance, executing of tests on Test set HW environment as a test conductor with SQA as witness.
•	Developed and implemented Navy Report back software capability for EPS-R FSW including performing Unit Testing, code coverage, Coverity static code analysis, and Regression testing for EPS-R FSW.
•	Conducted code review for external customer approval.
•	Analyzed test set results while validating test set telemetry communicated as intended via MIL-STD 1553 and UART. Depending on the test configurations, it was often required to burn EEPROM for specific images before executing specific tests.

positions.title: Systems Engineer (II)
positions.description:
Northrop Grumman Pathway
(Professional Development Program)

Program: JSF F-35 CNI
•	Introductory CAM training.
•	Developed Hardware Requirement Specification for new STE.
•	Designed new hardware STE to meet customer testing requirements for the transceiver module level testing and plan for delivery to international supplier. 
•	Prepared, hosted, and scheduled Project Kick offs, Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), and Critical Design Reviews (CDR) with production stakeholders and subject matter experts.
•	Develop validation plans for multiple power amplifier STEs including test platforms for module calibration and ATP (Acceptance Test Procedure) to ensure system requirements and the program delivery milestones are met
